entries.name: Diploma in Automotive Technology
entries.definition: A vocational diploma awarded on completing a programme of study in automotive technology.

entries.name: Diploma in Carpentry
entries.definition: A vocational diploma awarded on completing a programme of study in carpentry.

entries.name: Diploma in Cosmetology
entries.definition: A vocational diploma awarded on completing a programme of study in cosmetology.

entries.name: Diploma in Culinary Arts
entries.definition: A vocational diploma awarded on completing a programme of study in culinary arts.

entries.name: Diploma in Diesel Mechanic Technology
entries.definition: A vocational diploma awarded on completing a programme of study in diesel mechanic technology.

entries.name: Diploma in Emergency Medical Technician (EMT)
entries.definition: A vocational diploma awarded on completing a programme of study in emergency medical technician (EMT) training.

entries.name: Diploma in Esthetics
entries.definition: A vocational diploma awarded on completing a programme of study in esthetics.

entries.name: Diploma in Hotel Management and Catering Technology
entries.definition: A diploma, awarded by technical boards and polytechnic institutions in India, covering hotel operations, food production and catering.

entries.name: Diploma in HVAC (Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning) Repair
entries.definition: A vocational diploma awarded on completing a programme of study in heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) repair.

entries.name: Diploma in Marine Mechanic Technology
entries.definition: A vocational diploma awarded on completing a programme of study in marine mechanic technology.

entries.name: Diploma in Massage Therapy
entries.definition: A vocational diploma awarded on completing a programme of study in massage therapy.

entries.name: Diploma in Medical Assistant
entries.definition: A vocational diploma awarded on completing a programme of study in medical assisting.

entries.name: Diploma in Medical Billing and Coding
entries.definition: A vocational diploma awarded on completing a programme of study in medical billing and coding.

entries.name: Diploma in Surgical Technology
entries.definition: A vocational diploma awarded on completing a programme of study in surgical technology.

entries.name: Divemaster
entries.definition: A professional scuba-diving rating for people who lead and supervise certified divers, awarded by diving training agencies such as PADI, SSI and NAUI.

entries.name: Doctor of Dental Medicine
entries.definition: A professional doctoral degree in dentistry, awarded by dental schools in the United States and elsewhere.

entries.name: Doctor of Dental Surgery
entries.definition: A professional doctoral degree in dentistry, awarded by dental schools in the United States and elsewhere.

entries.name: Doctor of Medicine
entries.definition: A professional doctoral degree in medicine that qualifies graduates to go on to practise as physicians.

entries.name: Doctor of Nursing Practice
entries.definition: A practice-focused doctoral degree in nursing for advanced clinical practice, leadership and nursing care improvement.

entries.name: Doctor of Pharmacy
entries.definition: A professional doctoral degree in pharmacy that qualifies graduates to go on to practise as pharmacists.

entries.name: Doctor of Physical Therapy
entries.definition: A doctoral degree that qualifies graduates to practise as physical therapists in the United States.

entries.name: Doctor of Public Health
entries.definition: A doctoral degree in public health focused on professional practice and leadership.

entries.name: Doctor of Veterinary Medicine
entries.definition: A professional doctoral degree in veterinary medicine, awarded as DVM by most schools and as VMD by the University of Pennsylvania.

entries.name: Doubles/triples endorsement
entries.definition: A commercial driver's licence endorsement that permits towing two or three trailers.

entries.name: Driver's license
entries.definition: A government-issued licence that permits a person to drive motor vehicles on public roads.

entries.name: Drone pilot certificate
entries.definition: A certificate that allows a person to fly small unmanned aircraft commercially; in the United States, the FAA Remote Pilot Certificate under Part 107.

entries.name: Electric Vehicle Infrastructure Training Program
entries.definition: A US training and certification programme for electricians who install electric vehicle charging equipment.

entries.name: Emergency Medical Responder
entries.definition: An entry-level emergency medical care credential, below Emergency Medical Technician, for giving immediate lifesaving care until more advanced help arrives.

entries.name: Emergency Nurse Pediatric Course
entries.definition: A pediatric emergency nursing course from the Emergency Nurses Association whose completion earns a provider card.

entries.name: Engineer in Training
entries.definition: A US designation given by a state licensing board to a graduate engineer who has passed the Fundamentals of Engineering exam, the first step toward a Professional Engineer licence.

entries.name: Enhanced Security Check (eSC) clearance
entries.definition: A UK government security clearance level that adds further checks to the Security Check (SC) level.

entries.name: Expanded Functions Dental Assistant
entries.definition: A state-recognised credential that lets a dental assistant do extra tasks, such as placing and finishing restorations, under a dentist's supervision.

entries.name: Facilities Management Administrator
entries.definition: A professional designation in facilities management awarded by BOMI International to people who complete its coursework and exams.

entries.name: Family Nurse Practitioner
entries.definition: A nurse practitioner credential for providing primary care to patients of all ages, from infants to older adults.

entries.name: Fellow of the Casualty Actuarial Society
entries.definition: The highest actuarial designation awarded by the Casualty Actuarial Society to property and casualty actuaries who pass its exams and meet its other requirements.
variants: Fellow In The Casualty Actuarial Society

entries.name: Fellow of the Society of Actuaries
entries.definition: The highest actuarial designation awarded by the Society of Actuaries to candidates who pass its fellowship exams and meet its other requirements.

entries.name: Flagger certification
entries.definition: A certificate showing that a person has been trained to direct traffic safely through road work zones as a flagger.

entries.name: Flight attendant certification
entries.definition: A credential showing that a person has completed the safety training and met the regulatory requirements to work as cabin crew on commercial flights.

entries.name: FMCSA Certified Medical Examiner
entries.definition: A certification, through the US Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration's National Registry, that lets a health professional perform medical examinations for commercial truck and bus drivers.

entries.name: Forklift certification
entries.definition: A certificate showing that a person has been trained and evaluated to operate a forklift safely.
